modules.title: Introduction to Conic Sections
modules.html:
The circle, parabola, ellipse and hyperbola. This section covers introduction to conic sections.

Key points

  • Study the meaning, main features and examples of conic sections.
  • Be able to explain conic sections in your own words and give examples.
  • Practise the 50-question quiz for this topic until you score well without notes.

Worked examples

Q: Evaluate $$ \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin 3x}{x} $$.
A: 3 — Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: 3.

Q: Find the center of the circle $$ x^2 + y^2 - 4x + 6y = 0 $$.
A: (2, -3) — Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: (2, -3).

examples.q: Find the center of the circle $$ x^2 + y^2 - 4x + 6y = 0 $$.
